scope: Every tracked path in recovery git ls-files --stage at source_commit; gitlinks inventoried as one path, not recursively expanded. Classification is a reuse decision, not a license grant.

restricted-overlay.rationale: Listed by curated release local-dependency manifest; retain local-only overlay, never copy into Exhume.

historical.rationale: Session transcripts, plans, experimental receipts or superseded intermediate stages: retain source-project history; extract a portable lesson only.

gnu.rationale: Optional GNU/binutils/objconv pipeline and patches; independently licensed upstream sources, not MIT Exhume core.

format.rationale: Generic LE/OMF32 parsing, relocation/contribution and native-library structure; candidate for minimal fixture-tested upstream extraction.

runner.rationale: DOS runner or compiler-media preparation; reuse generic contracts with explicit identities and no tool/media payloads.

provenance.rationale: Generic proof/input-lifetime or preservation boundary pattern; remove Duke coordinates, descriptors and mutable research dependencies before reuse.

release.rationale: Publication boundary and dependency/source snapshot pattern; curated-release verifier/importer is the better source-release reference.

compiler.rationale: Measured compiler/runtime/container knowledge; retain versions, counterexamples and qualification; rewrite as profile guidance.

project.rationale: Duke source, module/evidence selectors, native layout plans, exploratory proof or project wiring; link as case-study evidence, do not import bodies.

unresolved-mact-asm.rationale: Recovery-authored assembly headers/provenance retain uncertainty. Original GPL-released v1.5 bundle contains the identical binary library, GNU.TXT and GPL interface headers, but no corresponding ASM source. This is an unresolved attribution/grant question, not an established restrictive vendor license.
